The union of the Who's On First region records Vavuniyāva (85673757), Mannārama (85673761), Mulativ (85673765), Yāpanaya (85673769), Kilinŏchchi (85673773). A record is assigned to the first-level division GeoNames files the populated places inside its boundary under. For each of the 25 records, at least 89 percent of those places are under one division.
